source.directorySummary: Implements the file `commit` command that validates the selected changed files and index state, stages/unstages to match the selection, and creates a git commit with the provided message.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts FileCommandAdapterParams into a commitSelectedFiles call by extracting message and file selections from JSON payload or arguments, resolving the repository root, and formatting the result as text.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Exports the `commit` subcommand definition with a required variadic string `message` argument for committing selected git diff files.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Implements commitSelectedFiles to validate message and selection, verify the staged index matches expected state, sync staging via git add and restore --staged to the selected changed files, and create the commit returning hash, summary, and committed files.

summary.value: Implements the file `commit` command that validates the selected changed files and index state, stages/unstages to match the selection, and creates a git commit with the provided message.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf git-write subcommand within the plugins/file/commands 20-command aggregation — the sole index/history-mutating member of the git-operation family (commit/diff/history/restore/init). Invoked via the centralized handleFile dispatcher fan-out in adapter.ts/init.ts, it closes the inspect-via-diff/history → persist loop. Delegates workspace-root resolution and containment validation to shared/ and CLI/web formatting to adapter.ts, isolating transactional git logic to its handler core with no child directories.

files.adapter.ts: CLI/web adaptation edge for this leaf — translates FileCommandAdapterParams (JSON payload or variadic args) into handler's commitSelectedFiles domain call, resolves repository root, and formats result as text. Implements the shared validate-containment → execute → adapt pattern, keeping transport/parsing separate from git mutation in handler.ts.
files.definition.ts: Declarative registration contract for the file plugin's command container — exports the variadic string `message` argument definition that defines the external CLI shape. Enables discovery/routing by init.ts and the central dispatcher without owning execution, bridging user invocation to adapter.ts/handler.ts.
files.handler.ts: Transactional core and only state-mutating file in this directory — owns message/selection/index-state validation, reconciles staging via git add / restore --staged to match selected changed files, and creates the commit returning hash/summary/committed files. Depends on adapter-provided inputs and complements read-only siblings diff/history and inverse operation restore.
